items.title: Quincy Jones — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Placido Domingo has called me about an opera.

ctx.x: Simon Rattle and the Berlin Philharmonic. He calls me all the time. “I’m want you to do a tour. I’m want you to do a tour,” 25 dates or something. I said, “No, I’ve got to get ready for that.” Placido Domingo has called me about an opera. I said, “You don’t knock that out in a week. That’s two years.”
